_comment: ONE axis of observable surface features, MULTI-LABEL, nothing competes. Revised 2026-08-20 so that every label names something the capture can actually resolve. A 250 mm tile at ~1.5 px/mm cannot show a 1 mm crack, cannot show the lip that defines a spall, and cannot show the age cues that separate demolition breakage from in-service deterioration. Labels requiring that evidence were retired rather than left in place producing confident errors. Array ORDER is the stored feature_id: append only, never reorder.
_display_order: Rendering precedence only. The 3D viewer and the combined feature map can show one colour per face, so when a region carries several features this decides which is drawn on top. It makes no claim about what the surface IS.
_basis: Built from what is observable at the corpus texel density rather than from inspection practice. ACI 201.1R, EN 1504, CODEBRIM and dacl10k all assume in-service structures photographed at close range; neither holds for demolition debris captured by handheld photogrammetry, so their condition categories cannot transfer intact. `fracture_surface` and `spalling` were merged into `broken_face` because separating them requires the boundary against sound surface and the age of the exposed faces, and an expert annotator could not apply the distinction to these tiles either. Three questions: formation (how the surface came to be), composition (what it is made of), inclusion (what is embedded in it), colour (what is on it). Groups are for reporting, not exclusivity.
_reference_set: 01_input/reference_surfaces/<label>/*.png holds labelled exemplar crops from this same building. When present they are sent ahead of the regions on every call and define what each label means for this material, so the model matches against samples instead of interpreting a verbal definition alone. Build candidates with 03_src/build_reference_set.py. The set is hashed into the API cache key: swapping an exemplar changes the standard and correctly invalidates cached answers. Exemplars chosen by eye make the classifier agree with whoever chose them, which is an operational definition of the categories and not validation; report it as such.
_acquisition_note: Known limitation of the acquisition method, not of the classifier. Photogrammetry cannot reconstruct an element thinner than roughly its point spacing, so a protruding reinforcing bar is missing from the mesh while remaining fully visible in the source photographs. The bake then projects it onto whatever geometry lies behind it, and it arrives in the atlas as a dark line on a flat face. This makes one feature produce two errors at once: crack is over-reported and rebar_visible under-reported. Neither is separable by geometry, since both a crack and an absent bar leave a flat surface. The hints for both labels now describe the colour cue that distinguishes them. See PLAN_texture_quality.md.

features.description: Original cast face; smooth, shows mould texture or release agent
features.decision_rule: Formed against formwork or a mould, with the evidence VISIBLE in this image: board marks, panel joints, tie holes, a release-agent sheen, or an unbroken skin of paste with no aggregate cut through. If no mould evidence is visible, do not use this label even if the surface is flat.

features.description: Internal concrete exposed by demolition break; rough
features.decision_rule: The surface is a break through the body of the concrete: irregular across the whole region, with aggregate and paste both cut and pulled. Covers any loss of material from the piece regardless of cause. Do NOT try to distinguish demolition breakage from deterioration: that needs the boundary against sound surface and the age of the exposed faces, and neither is legible here.

Coarse aggregate particles are a dominant part of what you see, whether cut through by a break, pulled from the paste, or washed clear. Report it whenever true, including on a broken face, where it usually is.

Steel reinforcement is visible: a bar, a mat, a stirrup or a cut end. Judge by ferrous colour, rust orange-brown or steel grey, and by constant width. A bar protruding from the fragment is often too thin for photogrammetry to reconstruct and appears painted onto the surface behind it, so do not require raised relief.

features.description: RETIRED — not observable at this capture resolution
features.decision_rule: Requires comparison against fresh concrete of the same mix, which is never in frame at 250 mm. Retired 2026-08-20.

RETIRED 2026-08-20. On the 26-tile held-out set the model predicted it on 8 tiles where the truth was 1: recall 100%, precision 12%. It had become the label reached for whenever anything looked unusual, including the orange of a cast-in brick, and its false positives were the entire precision gap against a null model. Colour alone does not separate contamination from the concrete's own variation at this capture quality.
An applied layer covers the concrete: tile, mosaic, plaster, render or screed. Judge the layer, not the concrete beneath it.

features.description: Steel that is not reinforcement: a fixing, angle, plate or c
features.decision_rule: Steel that is not reinforcement: a fixing, angle, plate or conduit cast into the element. A discrete component rather than a bar in a mat.

features.description: Adhered tile finish: tile itself, or the combed adhesive bed it left
features.decision_rule: An adhered tile finish in either state: tile still stuck to the concrete, or the bare cement bedding left where tiles came away, recognisable by the parallel ridges of a notched trowel, often alternating direction tile to tile. Machine-regular, which no concrete surface is.
features.treatment: tile is lifted off; a bare adhesive bed is ground back or keyed. See finishing_requirement 'strip_bedding' in env/design_factors.json.
features._note: A tiled face was a floor finish, so it identifies the TOP of the slab. In this corpus the slab tops are tiled rather than left as bare floated concrete, which is why trowelled_finish may return nothing.

features.description: The region IS the inner surface of a former pipe or conduit
features.decision_rule: A hole passing into or through the fragment: a service penetration, duct or cast-in sleeve. Dark interior going darker toward the centre, usually with a rim where the surface turns into the bore.
features.source: project-defined; not in CODEBRIM or dacl10k, both of which cover defects rather than cast features

features.description: Brick or masonry units cast into the concrete and visible at
features.decision_rule: Brick or masonry unit cast into the concrete and visible at the surface, whole or cut through by a break. Judge by the fired colour and by a module larger than any aggregate particle.

features.description: cement paste, fines or a coating cover the surface and individual aggregate particles are largely hidden
features.decision_rule: Cement paste, fines or a surface skin cover the face and individual aggregate particles are largely hidden.

features.description: RETIRED — not observable at this capture resolution
features.decision_rule: Defined by the lip where sound surface meets loss. A spall crater is usually larger than the sampling window, so the lip is not in frame and the interior is indistinguishable from a break. Merged into broken_face. Retired 2026-08-20.

features.description: RETIRED — not observable at this capture resolution
features.decision_rule: 0.5 to 3 mm wide, which is 0.5 to 3 px at the corpus texel density of ~1.5 px/mm. Below resolution. Every crack reported in the 2026-08-20 corpus was a false positive. Retired 2026-08-20.
features.source: CODEBRIM 'crack' [Mundt et al. 2019]; dacl10k 'Crack' [Flotzinger et al. 2024]

features.description: moss, algae or lichen: green, grey-green or black organic film, usually where water sits or runs. Marks the face that was exposed to weather
features.decision_rule: Moss, algae or lichen: green, grey-green or black organic film, usually where water sits or runs. Marks a face that was exposed to weather.

features.description: RETIRED — not observable at this capture resolution
features.decision_rule: Plausible by colour but absent from 26 blind-sampled tiles. Retired 2026-08-20 pending evidence it occurs in this stock.

features.description: The finished top face of a slab, floated or power-floated rather than cast against formwork
features.decision_rule: The concrete's own finished top surface, floated or power-floated. Smooth and dense with fine paste at the surface, and NO ridges. Distinct from tile_remnant, which is an applied bedding layer with regular comb ridges.

_display_precedence_note: Rendering only; it never affects which features are recorded. A face can hold several features but can only be painted one colour, so this decides which one wins. Ordered rarest-first as of 2026-08-25. The previous order was rarest-last, and because broken_face and exposed_aggregate together cover almost every classified region, broken_face won 61 of 72 regions across the corpus and the viewer was uniformly its red. FS-010 region 4 carried brick_inclusion and still rendered as broken_face. A colour showing what is true nearly everywhere carries no information; the distinctive features are the ones worth seeing, so they now sit on top.
